Subject: Temporary reservation hold + hardware variance — approval request

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Heads-up on an urgent ask from Cyclone AI (account CYC-2027-0421). Ellen (ops@cyclone.ai) looped us this morning: they hit an immediate capacity shortfall on H100 inventory in their region and are asking for a temporary hold on their reservation while we give them a fallback to A100 for two weeks. They want the hold to avoid immediate throttling of production jobs while they shift traffic.

Summary of the ask (see attached capacity_request.pdf and usage_report_q3.csv):
- Temporary reservation hold on 2 x H100 reserved units for 14 days (avoid churn triggers)
- Allow fallback to A100 variant for the same reserved capacity during that window
- Wave the 20% transient premium we normally charge for burst hardware for the first 7 days
- Cap overage rate at 1.5x base on-demand pricing for the window (instead of open market)

Proposed internal concession (what I recommend):
- Approve A100 fallback for the 14-day window
- One-time non-recurring credit of $15,000 applied to next invoice (instead of full 20% premium waiver)
- Cap overage at 1.5x base rate for the hold period
- Put reservation into a temporary hold state through Sep 5, 2027 (no churn, no auto-cancel)

Why: Cyclone is strategic in our A/P region, is mid-contract (12 mo left), and we risk them moving incremental workloads to a competitor if they experience big production disruption. The requested concession materially reduces immediate friction and is recoverable as non-recurring. Finance impact estimate in attachments.

Asking for explicit approval from Revenue Ops / Exec to proceed with customer-facing language below. If approved, I will send the note to Ellen and operations and coordinate with Billing to record concession type and GL.

Draft email to customer (if approved):
"Ellen — we can temporarily hold your H100 reservation through Sep 5 and enable A100 fallback for the affected units. We'll apply a one-time $15k credit and cap overage at 1.5x base on-demand pricing during the hold window. This is a one-off accommodation while inventory normalizes. Please confirm you accept these terms and we'll implement immediately."

Attachments: capacity_request.pdf (customer ask), usage_report_q3.csv (their token/throughput profile).

Thanks — please advise.

— Priyom

2) Legal/Terms: does this change require a signed amendment or can we proceed via email confirmation (we need to know for billing/accounting).

Karthik — answers inline: 

1) Cost/cap calculation: The $15k credit is a partial concession. Quick math (based on usage_report_q3):
   - Estimated 14-day incremental spend at on-demand H100 rates: $42,000
   - 20% transient premium on typical burst ~ $8,400 over 7 days; full waiver would be ~$8.4k not $40k. The larger delta is from the replacement A100 delta vs H100 performance, not a premium fee.
   - Our internal forecast: revenue delta vs expected if H100 were available is ~$38k in gross margin exposure if we fully discount/fallback without any credit. The $15k credit reduces customer friction while keeping our hit to ~ $23k.

2) Legal/Terms: Per quick check with legal (they authorized me to proceed with an email confirmation for this time-boxed operational hold; no amendment required). But they asked that we log "non-recurring concession" and include the agreed end date in the confirmation.

3) Precedent exposure: Agreed — I will document in Deal Desk notes and include Finance GL codes. Marissa, please confirm you can apply a one-time credit and flag this as non-recurring for revenue reporting.

Proposed final customer wording (if you approve):
"Ellen — we appreciate the urgency. We will place your H100 reservation into a temporary hold through Sep 5, 2027 and enable A100 fallback for the affected units. Redwood will apply a one-time $15,000 credit to your next invoice and cap any overage at 1.5x base on-demand pricing during the hold window. This is a single, time-limited accommodation and will be recorded as a non-recurring concession"

If you approve, I’ll send that to Ellen and coordinate with Billing to implement the reservation hold.

— Priyom

Thanks for the clear analysis and proposed language. I approve the adjusted concession with the following firm constraints: 

1) Approve A100 fallback for the 14-day window and a temporary reservation hold through Sep 5, 2027.
2) Approve one-time credit of $15,000 (non-recurring).
3) Approve capping overage at 1.5x base on-demand rate during the hold period.
4) This is a single-instance accommodation for Cyclone AI only. No broader policy change — any similar future requests must go through Deal Desk with Finance sign-off.
5) Billing/Finance: Marissa, please apply credit and tag this as "non-recurring concession" in revenue reporting and update the Deal Desk record.
6) Legal: please archive customer email acceptance as sufficient documentation.

Priyom — send the customer note below and confirm when the reservation hold is in place. Karthik — thanks for the quick review.

Approved.
